title: Sample Cleanup for Covaris Samples in Library Prep
author: Opentrons
materials: After an incubation, magnets are engaged.

steps.title: Enter engage height
steps.instruction: Enter the engage height for the custom labware on the magnetic module as a protocol parameter before starting the run.

steps.title: Verify reagents on deck
steps.instruction: Confirm that magnetic beads, 1× TE buffer, and 80 % ethanol are loaded on the deck in sufficient volumes.

steps.title: Dispense beads and mix
steps.instruction: Using the P300 multi‑channel pipette, dispense the magnetic beads into each well of the 96‑well PCR plate on the magnetic module and mix the contents.

steps.title: Remove bead supernatants
steps.instruction: After the incubation period, engage the magnets, then use the P300 multi‑channel pipette to remove and discard the supernatant from each bead pellet.

substeps.instruction: Incubate the plate for the required time (as defined by the downstream application).
Engage the magnetic module to collect the beads.
Aspirate and discard the supernatant from each well with the P300 multi‑channel pipette.

steps.title: Ethanol wash bead pellets
steps.instruction: Perform two washes of the bead pellets with 80 % ethanol using the P300 multi‑channel pipette.

substeps.instruction: Add 80 % ethanol to each well, let stand briefly, then remove and discard the ethanol.
Repeat the ethanol addition and removal for a second wash.

steps.title: Resuspend beads in TE
steps.instruction: After air‑drying the bead pellets, add 1× TE buffer, resuspend the beads, and mix using the P20 multi‑channel pipette.

substeps.instruction: Allow the bead pellets to air‑dry for the recommended time.
Add 1× TE buffer to each well.
Resuspend and mix the beads with the P20 multi‑channel pipette.

steps.title: Engage magnets after incubation
steps.instruction: Following the incubation step, engage the magnetic module to collect the beads.
